LanguageData.IM_ExternalSettings: This mod uses a separate settings window. Open it with the button below and save changes in that window.
LanguageData.IM_RememberStateTip: Restore the last page, search, and scroll position. Mod settings themselves stay owned by each mod.
LanguageData.IM_ShowMainButton: Show IrisMenus button in the bottom bar
LanguageData.IM_ShowMainButtonTip: Takes effect immediately. When hidden, open IrisMenus from Options → Mod settings → IrisMenus → Open IrisMenus.
LanguageData.IM_PageFailed: This settings page could not be displayed.
LanguageData.IM_OperationFailed: IrisMenus could not complete the operation. See the log for details.
LanguageData.IM_ActionUnavailable: This action is not available right now.
LanguageData.IM_ActionFailed: The action could not be completed. See the log for details.
LanguageData.IM_NativeMotionHint: Turn off to show the final state immediately when opening panels and changing controls.
LanguageData.IM_NativeOpacityHint: Controls the setting panel's opacity over the gradient background. At 100%, the panel is solid.
LanguageData.IM_NativeRememberHint: Reopen the last page and restore remembered browsing positions. Turning this off clears saved browsing positions.
LanguageData.IM_NativeMainButtonHint: Changes immediately. IrisMenus remains available through Options → Mod settings → IrisMenus.
LanguageData.IM_NativeTipDelayHint: How long to wait before showing an IrisMenus hover tip, in milliseconds.
LanguageData.IM_NativeDisplayNote: Scale changes the full-screen interface size. Density changes row spacing. Motion effects apply to full-screen panels and controls.
LanguageData.IM_NativeBackgroundNote: The full-screen interface uses a three-stop gray gradient, with a separate dark palette. Panel opacity defaults to 94% and does not affect the old interface's frost or blur settings.
LanguageData.IM_NativeNavigationNote: Remember last page restores your browsing position when IrisMenus opens. The default search scope chooses all mods or the current mod when starting a search from a page.
LanguageData.IM_NativeInteractionNote: Hover tips explain full-screen IrisMenus controls. Adjust the delay to change how soon they appear, or turn tips off.
LanguageData.IM_NativeModeTip: Switch between the original window and the full-screen interface. Current settings must save successfully before switching.
LanguageData.IM_NativeChoosePage: Select a mod from the library to open its settings.
LanguageData.IM_NativeAliasDescription: Choose a name for this mod. Leave it empty to restore its default name.
LanguageData.IM_NativeResetDescription: Restore the settings declared by this page. Other pages, mods and window geometry are not changed.
LanguageData.IM_NativeHelpDescription: Full-screen IrisMenus uses the same settings pages and save owners as the original interface. Hosted pages retain their controls and layout while ordinary backgrounds and text follow the current theme. Chapters, notes, previews and reset are shown only when a page explicitly provides them. The interface switch preserves the current page and browsing position.
LanguageData.IM_NativeManagementTitle: Add mods to the settings library
LanguageData.IM_NativeManagementHint: Choose which hosted settings appear in IrisMenus. This does not enable or disable game mods.
LanguageData.IM_ValueColorsHint: Colors use the market value of one item, not its stack. Each band includes its starting value and ends at the next band's start; the final band has no upper limit. The first band always starts at 0. Click a color to edit it; changes take effect when you apply the color.
LanguageData.IM_ValueThresholdInvalid: Enter a finite value above the previous start and below the next start.
LanguageData.IM_ValueResetConfirm: Restore the default item value bands and colors? Other settings are not changed.
LanguageData.IM_RegistrySearch: Search name, DefName or source mod
LanguageData.IM_SaveHint: Changes apply immediately. Settings save when you leave the page.
